Dixon Residential Estate Agents are delighted to present 63 The Square to the Drogheda property market. 

On entrance to this beautiful property, we are met with an entrance hallway, the spacious living / dining room area is located to the front of the home. Down the hallway, we are met with the kitchen area. The master bedroom is located to the rear of the property and contains an en-suite. The large secondary bedroom is also located to the rear, while a modern family bathroom completes the accomodation.

The Square, Riverbank is located within minutes of Drogheda town centre. This property is within minutes from an abundance of amenities such as crèches, primary schools, secondary schools, shops, churches, Our Lady of Lourdes Hospital, sports clubs and restaurants. There are great transport links with bus stops close by, Drogheda Train Station and access to the M1 motorway.
